step_1_desc: Choose the crop field or plot to assess.
step_2_desc: Position camera 10-20 cm above diseased foliage in good daylight.
step_3_desc: Validating focus sharpness, lighting exposure, and resolution.
step_4_desc: Running offline neural pathology classification on edge accelerator.
step_5_desc: Reading live RS485 Modbus soil parameters (N, P, K, pH, Moisture, Temp).
step_6_desc: Synthesizing multi-modal signals and calculating field risk level.
step_7_desc: Personalized, non-toxic agronomic guidance saved locally in SQLite.
quality_valid: Image quality is optimal for AI diagnosis.
quality_blurry: Image is too blurry. Hold camera steady and focus on the leaf.
quality_dark: Image is too dark. Improve natural lighting.
quality_bright: Image is overexposed. Reduce harsh sunlight glare.
quality_small: Image resolution too low. Move closer to the crop.
